With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships \u2013 all united by our\u202fpioneering\u202fagentic marketing platform, WPP Open \u2013 we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media is WPP&#39;s AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information, visit &lt;a href=&quot;wppmedia.com&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;3392 - VP, Activation and Delivery, UK&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Summary and Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The VP, Paid Search is accountable for leading a high-performing Paid Search team and shaping the strategic direction, delivery excellence, innovation agenda and commercial growth of the channel across a defined client portfolio and the wider MM&amp;amp;D UK business. This VP, Paid Search role will be part of the new Outcomes Activation &amp;amp; Delivery hub, a newly formed team bringing together key clients from across WPP Media focused on delivering measurable business outcome growth for clients.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a senior leadership role that goes beyond day-to-day channel management. The VP will own Paid Search channel excellence for Outcomes Hub, translating client business challenges into progressive search strategies, and ensuring Paid Search is positioned as a strategic growth lever across performance, customer experience, commerce and broader media transformation.&lt;br&gt;The role requires expert-level Paid Search knowledge, strong commercial judgement, confident client leadership and the ability to build narratives that connect platform innovation, automation, AI, data, measurement and audience behaviour to tangible business outcomes. It also requires a strong understanding of where Paid Search overlaps with Organic Search, Content, Digital PR, AI search environments, and the evolving Total Search proposition.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The successful candidate will lead and nurture a thriving search community that is head and shoulders above the competition, consistently meeting the needs of clients while proactively identifying opportunities to surprise, delight and improve outcomes. They will ensure the team has access to the latest tools, training, resources and innovation opportunities, and will play an active role in shaping agency leadership, MM&amp;amp;D UK delivery initiatives, narratives and workstreams.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Leadership, talent and community&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Lead, motivate and develop a high-performing Paid Search team, creating a culture of accountability, curiosity, high standards and continuous improvement.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Line manage Directors and\/or Associate Directors, ensuring every team member has clear objectives, regular performance conversations and meaningful development plans.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Identify talent gaps across the Paid Search team and work with HR and leadership to recruit, retain and grow talent aligned to the agency&#39;s values, client needs and future capability requirements.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Provide coaching, mentorship and professional development opportunities, helping teams build both technical depth and broader strategic confidence.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Evangelise best-in-class Paid Search delivery across the team, ensuring people understand what excellent work looks like and feel enabled to deliver it consistently.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Ensure the Paid Search team is equipped with the knowledge, skills and commercial understanding required to operate within a Total Search environment, including traditional SEO, Generative Search Optimisation (GSO), Commerce Search and Social Search, fostering greater collaboration, integration and client impact across disciplines.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Manage department resource levels effectively, balancing client demand, team wellbeing, delivery quality, profitability and growth opportunities.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Develop the global hub relationship, actively improving the range, complexity and quality of tasks the hub can support, while increasing utilisation and embedding clear ways of working.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Develop, evolve and champion our market-leading Paid Search proposition&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Define and own the strategic vision for Paid Search across the relevant client portfolio and team, ensuring our approach remains industry-leading, commercially differentiated and aligned to evolving client, consumer and platform behaviours.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Own channel excellence for the team, setting clear standards for planning, activation, optimisation, governance, testing, measurement, reporting and client-facing recommendations.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Support the development and execution of the Paid Search proposition and product strategy and roadmap, including new services, frameworks, operating models and best practice approaches that can scale across clients and MM&amp;amp;D UK.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Champion the use of AI, automation and technology-enabled solutions in a scalable way, developing innovative client-specific solutions that create competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Ensure the team remains at the forefront of innovation across Google, Microsoft, retail media, social search, search marketplaces, emerging search engines and AI-driven search experiences.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Translate broader client business challenges into Paid Search strategies that address growth, profitability, customer acquisition, demand generation, retention, conversion, market share and customer experience objectives.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Build proactive growth plans for the client portfolio they are accountable for, identifying opportunities for incremental revenue, scope expansion, product adoption, innovation pilots and strategic transformation.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Embed a proactive client culture where teams consistently identify opportunities to surprise and delight clients through innovation, improved performance, insight-led thinking, stronger narratives and market-leading recommendations.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Partner closely with SEO, Content, Digital PR, Analytics, Commerce, Audience and wider media teams to create integrated search solutions that maximise visibility, relevance and performance across the full customer journey.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Support the evolution of Integrated Search and the broader Total Search approach, connecting Paid Search, Organic Search, content strategy, AI search optimisation and measurement into a more joined-up client proposition.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Contribute to wider MM&amp;amp;D UK delivery initiatives, narratives and workstreams, ensuring Paid Search thinking is represented in agency-wide transformation, operational improvement, product development and thought leadership activity.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Work effectively with media partners such as Google, Microsoft and emerging search technologies to deepen capability, secure access to innovation, shape relevant POVs and translate partner developments into client value.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Bring together the appropriate specialists to ensure the development of appropriate client-specific measurement, attribution and technology solutions that solve paid search challenges and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Cooperate with wider WPP Media teams to elevate search standards, advance the Paid Search practice, shape the search agenda and support delivery of priority initiatives.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Client strategy, proactivity and commercial growth&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Act as a senior strategic advisor to client stakeholders, helping them understand how Paid Search can support broader business goals rather than operating as a standalone media channel.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Lead teams to interrogate client business context, market dynamics, customer behaviour, competitive pressure and commercial objectives, turning those inputs into ambitious but credible Paid Search strategies.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Ensure clients receive a gold standard product experience that is strategically progressive, data and technology led, commercially grounded and delivered in line with our product narrative.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Cultivate strong client relationships by providing exceptional operational output, clear strategic direction, proactive recommendations and a strong sense of ownership across every account.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Identify opportunities for growth across the Paid Search market and within the client portfolio, including new products, new scopes, automation-led efficiencies, performance improvement opportunities and integrated search propositions.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Identify and lead opportunities to expand Paid Search into broader Integrated Search and Total Search engagements, connecting SEO, Content, Digital PR, Analytics and wider media capabilities to solve client challenges and drive measurable business outcomes.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Ensure commercial objectives are fulfilled, including income growth, profitability, scope management, accurate forecasting and effective finance processes that reduce risk of write-offs, overspends and avoidable queries.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Lead Paid Search input into new business activity, codifying processes and reusable narratives that strengthen pitch quality, differentiation and conversion.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Support the creation of compelling client narratives that explain the role of Paid Search in a Total Search context. Considering a modern search behaviour, integrated planning, AI-enabled discovery, performance growth and customer decision-making.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Delivery excellence, governance and operational standards&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Implement best practice across the department by identifying, improving and rolling out processes that raise delivery quality, efficiency, consistency and client confidence.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Use automation and new technologies to enhance workflow systems, reduce manual effort, improve QA, support faster insight generation and increase the strategic value of team outputs.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Ensure teams apply robust QA, governance, data security, privacy and risk mitigation standards across all clients and delivery processes.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop sophisticated reporting and measurement frameworks that provide clients with actionable insight, clear performance narratives and business-focused recommendations.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional and central teams across the agency, ensuring Paid Search is effectively integrated into wider media planning, performance strategy and client transformation programmes.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Work across MM&amp;amp;D UK to ensure Paid Search is connected into overall marketing strategy, client operating models and agency-wide delivery priorities.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Act as the point of contact between partners and clients, ensuring clients have appropriate access to support, strategic direction, innovation opportunities and senior escalation routes when required.&lt;br&gt;Industry leadership, reputation and thought leadership&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Represent WPP Media at industry events, conferences, seminars and partner forums to showcase thought leadership and strengthen the agency&#39;s reputation in Paid Search and modern search.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Work in partnership with platforms and industry partners to ensure the agency has an ever-evolving search POV that is practical, differentiated and useful for clients.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Develop thought leadership, POVs, case studies, award entries and client-facing narratives that demonstrate the strategic value of Paid Search, Integrated Search and Total Search.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Submit and win award entries by identifying exceptional work, shaping strong effectiveness stories and encouraging teams to recognise and codify excellence.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills and Experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for candidates who are self-starters, commercially minded and motivated by the opportunity to push the boundaries of Paid Search. Successful candidates will combine deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, strong client judgement, operational rigour and the ability to inspire teams to deliver exceptional work.&lt;br&gt;It is essential that you have:&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Expert-level Paid Search knowledge across Google, Microsoft and broader search ecosystems, with an understanding of emerging search environments, retail media, marketplaces and AI-led discovery behaviours.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;A proven ability to lead large teams, set standards, manage performance, coach senior talent and build a culture of delivery excellence.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to map client business challenges to Paid Search priorities, integrated search opportunities and wider growth strategies.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;A proactive mindset and the confidence to question the status quo.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;A strong understanding of automation, AI, machine learning and workflow optimisation, with the judgement to apply technology in ways that improve quality, efficiency and strategic value.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Confidence working alongside GSO, SEO, Content, Analytics, Commerce, Audience and broader media teams to develop integrated search and Total Search solutions.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Excellent client leadership skills, including the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders, shape clear recommendations and translate complex channel thinking into commercially relevant narratives.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Immaculate attention to detail and a strong commitment to governance, QA, data security, privacy and financial control.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Experience developing products, frameworks, operating models, best practice guidance, thought leadership, award entries or pitch narratives.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;A strong external perspective, including awareness of industry trends, innovation, platform developments and changes in consumer search behaviour.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Commercial acumen, with experience identifying growth opportunities, managing resource, protecting profitability and supporting new business activity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What good looks like in the role&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Clients see Paid Search as a strategic growth lever, not just an activation channel.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;The team consistently delivers market-leading work with clear standards, strong governance and proactive recommendations.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Automation and AI are used responsibly to improve quality, efficiency, consistency and strategic focus.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Paid Search is actively connected with Organic Search, Content, Analytics, Commerce and wider media planning through Integrated Search and Total Search thinking.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;The client portfolio shows evidence of growth, innovation adoption, improved delivery quality and stronger commercial outcomes.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;The VP is recognised internally and externally as a leader who shapes the future of Paid Search, contributes to MM&amp;amp;D UK priorities and raises the standard of search delivery across the agency.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Life at WPP Media &amp;amp; Benefits&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Lead Optimistically,\u202ffirmly believing\u202fin and&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Championing Growth and Development&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to\u202fleverage\u202fthe extensive global WPP Media &amp;amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the\u202fcutting edge\u202fof marketing and advertising.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Create an Open environment&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events\u202fshowcasing\u202fteam wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About WPP Media&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world\u2019s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships \u2013 all united by our\u202fpioneering\u202fagentic marketing platform, WPP Open \u2013 we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media is WPP&#39;s AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information, visit &lt;a href=&quot;wppmedia.com&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;3054 - Snr MAI Paid Social Manager - GCS&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Summary and Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Wavemaker Worldwide Activation is the digital specialist arm of the worldwide hub. It powers the digital thinking for Wavemakers largest global clients and acts as a central planning and buying team for clients who buy multimarket digital campaigns from one location. Our digital thinking brings together media, data and technology to drive business results for our clients and is directly connected to our most senior global management team offering increased opportunity for senior level exposure.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Client Context:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Audible is Wavemaker Worldwide\u2019s largest client and one of the world\u2019s favourite platforms for audio content, from podcasts to audio books to Audible Originals. Audible have ambitious growth targets that we will help them achieve through both branding and performance campaigns across four major markets: France, Italy, Germany and Spain giving the applicate an opportunity to work across market and understand how different markets behaviour and respond to media.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Context:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a specialist in paid social app\/MAI campaigns to continue their career as Account Manager. This person will play an integral role in the day-to-day running of a busy client account. They will be required to work with the line manager to help oversee more junior team members with the overall aim of delivering flawless paid social campaigns for clients. The ideal candidate is someone with good working knowledge of paid advertising across one or more of the key social channels (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). The candidate should also have in-depth experience of working with mobile app-install campaigns across Meta, Reddit, Twitter, TikTok and Snapchat and also be proficient in understanding the specific challenges of mobile\/app campaign tracking including having worked with MMPs. This person will also be required to develop relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders becoming a trusted voice for all things paid social.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Account Managers are expected to work closely with their Account Director and the Global Hub team to manage the day-to-day running of one (or more) client accounts. Account Managers have several key areas of focus, these include:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Campaign Management&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Developing comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client\u2019s objectives and KPIs focussing on mobile app-install campaigns. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for end-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms (and working with junior team members to assist them with this task as necessary), focusing on app-install campaigns. Comfortable using advanced features such as bid rules and 3rd party optimisation\/ creative\/ measurement tools to achieve results for clients.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for ensuring regular quality assurance (QA) checks are undertaken by everyone working on the account (both locally and in the Global Hub team) to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure all activity delivers as expected. Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns in order to improve performance as necessary.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working with Executives, Snr. Executives and the Global Hub team to produce detailed &amp;amp; accurate weekly\/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel. Leading client calls to present results as necessary.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Should be able to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise\/mitigate these trends as necessary. Working with junior team members to ensure standards for commentary remain consistent.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Producing more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly\/annual reviews, and for standalone projects.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Owning the tracking of app-install campaigns across social activity.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Client &amp;amp; Partner Management&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency\u2019s social output.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client\u2019s business. Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, Twitter, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;People Management&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working with your line-manager to ensure the effective management of more junior team members ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored &amp;amp; prioritised to ensure deadlines are met.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Able to communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. Leading by example to motivate and encourage those with less experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assisting with the recruitment process for the immediate and wider team. Attending interviews and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Operational Excellence&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working with line-manager to develop and implement testing\/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for accurate and timely fulfilment of mandatory agency finance processes. Working with junior team members and the Global Hub team to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment\/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills and Experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate who can display the following attributes:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The successful candidate should have experience working in a digital marketing or agency-based role and will need to demonstrate a track record of working with clients or external stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive experience setting up and optimising paid social campaigns across a number of the key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). Training certifications in any of the key platforms would be a plus (e.g. Meta Blueprint).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience planning large-scale paid social campaigns including app-install campaigns with performance objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with mobile measurement platforms (such as Kochava or Appsflyer) and accompanying data-sets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience compiling detailed and insightful end of campaign reports &amp;amp; presentations. Knowledge of how to structure regular client review presentations (QBRs, annual reviews etc).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Forming strong relationships is key to the role, the ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting to clients and leading calls as required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Some experience line managing individuals and\/or helping to train others across paid social would be preferable.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;In return the successful candidate can expect to work as a member of a fun and engaging team that is part of a company that truly champions learning, development and will invest in your career over the long term.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Life at WPP Media &amp;amp; Benefits&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. Each team is custom-built around a client\u2019s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that\u2019s why we\u2019ve built &lt;strong&gt;OpenDoor &lt;\/strong&gt;for&lt;strong&gt; Amazon&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OpenDoor&lt;\/strong&gt; is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon \u2013 building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive &lt;em&gt;impact&lt;\/em&gt; \u2013 for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;OpenDoor\u2019s values draw on Amazon\u2019s &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.amazon.jobs\/content\/en\/our-workplace\/leadership-principles&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;16 Leadership Principles&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/a&gt; and WPP\u2019s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP\u2019s creative transformation and Amazon\u2019s customer focus empower our people to challenge today\u2019s conventions and build a better future.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP\u2019s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ABOUT THE ROLE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon\u2019s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;XCM is Amazon\u2019s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM\u2019s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;RESPONSIBILITIES&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Collaboration across OpenDoor and the wider WPP network is central to the role, with a strong focus on best practice, operational consistency and on-time delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Campaign delivery and coordination:&lt;\/strong&gt; Coordinate regional XCM campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions across client, internal and local market teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Client service and communication:&lt;\/strong&gt; Act as a professional point of contact for client enquiries and requests, providing clear updates on campaign progress, deliverables and performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Regional planning and reporting:&lt;\/strong&gt; Coordinate the accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reports, including weekly spend trackers, performance reports and campaign status updates.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Operational setup and governance:&lt;\/strong&gt; Set up and maintain reporting templates, trackers, campaign documentation and ways of working; coordinate inputs, complete quality checks and support consistent data and processes across markets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Finance and billing:&lt;\/strong&gt; Support finance processes by collating purchase orders, maintaining budget trackers, monitoring client billing, and escalating discrepancies or missing information.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Meetings and follow-up:&lt;\/strong&gt; Participate in and facilitate regular client, internal and creative agency meetings, preparing agendas and materials and documenting actions, owners and deadlines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate Global Campaign guidelines to local market teams, clarify requirements and support consistent implementation across markets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build strong relationships with regional departments, local OpenDoor teams and wider WPP partners, working effectively across locations and time zones.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop a strong understanding of Amazon\u2019s ways of working and the OpenDoor operating model to improve organisation, quality and consistency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;2\u20133 years\u2019 experience in media multiple priorities and deadlines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Awareness of the media and marketing industry, including key channels, emerging trends and planning principles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and geographically distributed working environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Good working knowledge of Principles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understanding of cross-channel media planning and how individual channels contribute to an integrated plan.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BENEFITS OF You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>Key responsibilities<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">In your capacity as a CAD &amp; Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>During the Design Phase:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design the thrust chamber &amp; injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification.<\/p><\/li><li><p Sur le campus de Nantes, les recherches sont focalis\u00e9es sur l\u2019analyse des transformations des organisations et des m\u00e9tiers dans des syst\u00e8mes sociotechniques. Trois domaines d\u2019investigation sont privil\u00e9gi\u00e9s : l\u2019industrie, la sant\u00e9 et l\u2019environnement. Le ou la candidate sera affil\u00e9\u00b7e au LEMNA (Laboratoire \u00c9conomie et Management Nantes Atlantique).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Plus pr\u00e9cis\u00e9ment, le poste sera rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la <a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.imt-atlantique.fr\/fr\/recherche-innovation\/collaborer\/chaires\/resoh\">chaire RESOH<\/a> [Recherche en S\u00e9curit\u00e9 Organisations Hommes]. Les travaux de recherche, \u00e0 l\u2019interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations \u00e0 hauts risques. Partant de l\u2019analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s\u2019agit d\u2019\u00e9clairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, manag\u00e9riales et institutionnelles contribuant \u00e0 (ou emp\u00eachant) le maintien d\u2019un niveau de fiabilit\u00e9 compatible avec les exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en \u00e9troite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. Elles visent \u00e0 produire des connaissances scientifiques fond\u00e9es sur des enqu\u00eates de terrain, mais \u00e9galement \u00e0 favoriser leur mise en discussion, leur appropriation et leur mobilisation par les acteurs concern\u00e9s. Dans ce contexte, la chaire souhaite renforcer ses capacit\u00e9s de valorisation, de diffusion et d\u2019appropriation de ses travaux, aupr\u00e8s de ses partenaires actuels comme, plus largement, du monde socio-\u00e9conomique.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">&nbsp;<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\"><strong><span style=\"color:#01B4D5\">2-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Les travaux de recherche, \u00e0 l\u2019interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations \u00e0 hauts risques. Partant de l\u2019analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s\u2019agit d\u2019\u00e9clairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, manag\u00e9riales et institutionnelles contribuant \u00e0 (ou emp\u00eachant) le maintien d\u2019un niveau de fiabilit\u00e9 compatible avec les exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en \u00e9troite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. concern\u00e9s.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><em>&nbsp;<\/em><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\"><strong><span style=\"color:#01B4D5\">MISSIONS<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\">En Participer \u00e0 des activit\u00e9s annexes du projet EMPOWR<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Participe \u00e0 la r\u00e9daction des livrables<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Participe aux assembl\u00e9es g\u00e9n\u00e9rales du projet ainsi qu\u2019aux r\u00e9unions techniques<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">R\u00e9dige des publications scientifiques<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3><span style=\"color:#1999e3\">Le Projet<\/span><\/h3><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019objectif principal du projet <strong>EMPOWR<\/strong> est d\u2019introduire un \u00e9cosyst\u00e8me d\u2019augmentation multicouches qui transformera les espaces de travail industriels en environnements adaptatifs et intelligents, o\u00f9 les travailleurs ne seront plus simplement des op\u00e9rateurs, mais des d\u00e9cideurs am\u00e9lior\u00e9s. Cet \u00e9cosyst\u00e8me favorisera la collaboration homme-machine gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 deux technologies cl\u00e9s : un <strong>outil de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9 adaptatif<\/strong>, accompagn\u00e9 d\u2019un <strong>compagnon IA cognitif<\/strong>, <em>Adaptive Learning Manufacturing Assistant<\/em><strong> (ALMA )<\/strong>, un syst\u00e8me d\u2019IA bas\u00e9 sur des mod\u00e8les de langage (LLM) qui jouera le r\u00f4le d\u2019intelligence de l\u2019espace de travail industriel.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3><span style=\"color:#1999e3\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe<\/span><\/h3><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe <strong>INUIT<\/strong> (Interaction Naturelle Immersive pour l\u2019Utilisateur) du d\u00e9partement Informatique m\u00e8ne des recherches sur l\u2019interaction en r\u00e9alit\u00e9 mixte en concevant des syst\u00e8mes de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 virtuelle et augment\u00e9e, en proposant des mod\u00e8les et des m\u00e9taphores \u00e9valu\u00e9s par des exp\u00e9riences utilisateurs. Les domaines d\u2019application incluent notamment l\u2019Industrie du Futur, la Sant\u00e9, la D\u00e9fense et le Patrimoine Culturel.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe <strong>INUIT<\/strong> est responsable de la conception et du d\u00e9veloppement de l\u2019outil de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9e adaptatif. Ce dernier int\u00e9grera un espace de conception en r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9e con\u00e7u pour prendre en charge plusieurs formes d\u2019affichage d\u2019informations via des augmentations. L\u2019affichage s\u2019appuiera en pratique sur des \u00e9l\u00e9ments fournis par ALMA ainsi que sur des signaux physiologiques surveill\u00e9s chez les travailleurs. L\u2019outil de RA sera d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 dans deux cas d\u2019usage industriels, et des \u00e9tudes utilisateurs seront men\u00e9es pour validation.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" b\u00e2ti face au changement climatique\"","description":"<p>Rejoindre <a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.mines-stetienne.fr\/\"><span style=\"color:#0563C1\">Mines Saint-\u00c9tienne<\/span><\/a>, c\u2019est s\u2019engager dans une institution o\u00f9 la <strong>science et l\u2019innovation b\u00e2tissent un avenir plus durable<\/strong>. Une \u00e9cole d\u2019excellence o\u00f9 chacun<strong>&nbsp;<\/strong>a<strong> l\u2019opportunit\u00e9 de r\u00e9v\u00e9ler son plein potentiel <\/strong>et de <strong>contribuer \u00e0 relever les d\u00e9fis de demain<\/strong>.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Class\u00e9e parmi les meilleures \u00e9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre \u00e9cole, membre de l\u2019Institut Mines-T\u00e9l\u00e9com, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement \u00e0 relever les grands d\u00e9fis industriels, num\u00e9riques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous int\u00e9grez une communaut\u00e9 de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 \u00e9tudiants, et participez \u00e0 un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence acad\u00e9mique, recherche d\u2019avant-garde et impact soci\u00e9tal positif.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=m39m6hdNC48\"><span style=\"color:#0563C1\">L\u2019Institut Mines-T\u00e9l\u00e9com<\/span><\/a> f\u00e9d\u00e8re les grandes \u00e9coles fran\u00e7aises autour des d\u00e9fis industriels majeurs, num\u00e9riques, \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et \u00e9cologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes \u00c9coles publiques et 2 \u00e9coles filiales, il est le premier institut public d\u00e9di\u00e9 aux ing\u00e9nieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui fa\u00e7onneront les transitions de demain.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong><em><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Transitions num\u00e9riques, \u00e9cologiques, industrielles : les grands d\u00e9fis de notre \u00e9poque sont aussi ceux de l\u2019Institut Henri Fayol.<\/span><\/em><\/strong><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Ici se m\u00ealent Informatique, Sciences des donn\u00e9es, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, G\u00e9nie environnemental pour penser les syst\u00e8mes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, fili\u00e8res industrielles.&nbsp;<\/span><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#000000\">\ud83d\udcca&nbsp;<\/span><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">R\u00e9silience, performance, durabilit\u00e9\u2026&nbsp;Nous d\u00e9veloppons et exp\u00e9rimentons en lien \u00e9troit avec les acteurs socio-\u00e9conomique pour r\u00e9pondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.<\/span><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#000000\">\u2728&nbsp;<\/span><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Une recherche interdisciplinaire \u00e0 fort impact, o\u00f9 l\u2019humain est toujours au centre.<\/span><span style=\"color:#000000\">&nbsp;<\/span><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>Cette th\u00e8se de doctorat sera rattach\u00e9e au d\u00e9partement G\u00e9nie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 (EVS). Pour r\u00e9pondre aux enjeux des transitions \u00e9cologique, \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et industrielle, le d\u00e9partement GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et priv\u00e9s) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de r\u00e9silience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi \u00e0 apporter des solutions nouvelles en mati\u00e8re d'analyse, de mod\u00e9lisation et d'\u00e9valuation environnementale des syst\u00e8mes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>\ud83c\udfe0 <strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Contexte <\/span><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Pr\u00e9sentation du sujet<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le changement climatique met en lumi\u00e8re, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vuln\u00e9rabilit\u00e9s et liens de d\u00e9pendance g\u00e9n\u00e9ralis\u00e9e de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les cha\u00eenes de valeur, et modes d'organisation \u00e9conomique et technique, \u00e9l\u00e9ments souvent d\u00e9connect\u00e9s de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du b\u00e2timent, Cimerman (2023) \u00e9voque une tendance depuis plusieurs d\u00e9cennies de \u00ab simplification cart\u00e9sienne \u00bb de la conception et de l'op\u00e9ration du b\u00e2ti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le d\u00e9veloppement d'un imaginaire de \u00ab b\u00e2timent-machine \u00bb, se traduisant par une superposition d'\u00e9l\u00e9ments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'\u00eatre pilot\u00e9s au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralis\u00e9e optimis\u00e9e (Cimerman, 2023).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Face aux enjeux pos\u00e9s par le changement climatique, deux voies oppos\u00e9es d'adaptation du b\u00e2ti se dessinent. La premi\u00e8re, actuellement dominante, consiste \u00e0 prolonger cet imaginaire de \u00ab b\u00e2timent-machine \u00bb, rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du d\u00e9veloppement du \u00ab smart-building \u00bb. Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des r\u00e9ponses cl\u00e9s-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralis\u00e9s, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de b\u00e2timents. N\u00e9anmoins, elle pr\u00e9sente certains d\u00e9fis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, co\u00fbteuses, complexes, rapidement obsol\u00e8tes et dont la fabrication repose en grande partie sur des ressources finies. Cela pose de plus les questions centrales des comp\u00e9tences, de la d\u00e9l\u00e9gation du savoir et des outils associ\u00e9s \u00e0 des op\u00e9rateurs experts externes.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">En contrepoint \u00e0 la premi\u00e8re voie, une seconde approche, encore marginale, \u00e9merge : celle d'un \u00ab b\u00e2timent low-tech \u00bb. Popularis\u00e9e ces derni\u00e8res ann\u00e9es en France par Philippe Bihouix (Bihouix, 2014), la low-tech questionne le rapport \u00e0 la technologie et aux diff\u00e9rentes formes de d\u00e9pendances qu'elle g\u00e9n\u00e8re (Tanguy et al., 2023). Dans le secteur du b\u00e2timent, l'application de cette d\u00e9marche renvoie souvent \u00e0 la d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource (\u00e9nergie et mati\u00e8re) : repenser les usages, l'origine des mat\u00e9riaux (r\u00e9employ\u00e9s, biosourc\u00e9s) ou encore la simplicit\u00e9 de l'\u00e9quipement utilis\u00e9. Bien que n\u00e9cessaires, ces travaux s'int\u00e9ressent pourtant peu \u00e0 d'autres formes de d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la technique, au titre desquelles nous pouvons citer la d\u00e9pendance aux savoirs et aux formes d'organisation sociale et \u00e9conomique qui conditionnent l'ad\u00e9quation, la p\u00e9rennit\u00e9 et l'efficacit\u00e9 des solutions propos\u00e9es.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Cette th\u00e8se offre ainsi une immersion concr\u00e8te dans les questions d'adaptation du parc b\u00e2ti au changement climatique par la \u00ab&nbsp;lowtech&nbsp;\u00bb \u00e0 l'interface entre sciences de l'ing\u00e9nieur et sciences humaines et sociales. Les comp\u00e9tences et l'exp\u00e9rience acquises trouveront une r\u00e9sonance particuli\u00e8re dans un secteur en pleine mutation, o\u00f9 la ma\u00eetrise des d\u00e9pendances techniques, \u00e9conomiques et organisationnelles devient un enjeu central pour la soutenabilit\u00e9 des b\u00e2timents et de leur exploitation.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Contexte scientifique<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La litt\u00e9rature consacr\u00e9e \u00e0 la low-tech s'est structur\u00e9e ces derni\u00e8res ann\u00e9es autour d'une critique de la fuite en avant technologique et des d\u00e9pendances qu'elle engendre (Bihouix, 2014 ; Tanguy et al., 2023). Appliqu\u00e9e au b\u00e2timent, cette litt\u00e9rature reste toutefois majoritairement centr\u00e9e sur la phase de conception et sur la d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource : sobri\u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique, choix de mat\u00e9riaux biosourc\u00e9s ou r\u00e9employ\u00e9s, r\u00e9duction du niveau d'\u00e9quipement technique.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Deux angles morts en d\u00e9coulent. Le premier concerne la phase d'exploitation : la maintenance et l'entretien, qui repr\u00e9sentent pourtant l'essentiel de la dur\u00e9e de vie d'un b\u00e2timent et conditionnent la performance r\u00e9elle des solutions install\u00e9es, sont peu trait\u00e9s comme objet de recherche \u00e0 part enti\u00e8re. Le second concerne la nature m\u00eame des d\u00e9pendances \u00e9tudi\u00e9es. Au-del\u00e0 de la ressource, la conduite d'une op\u00e9ration de maintenance mobilise des savoirs et savoir-faire, des outils de diagnostic, des pi\u00e8ces d\u00e9tach\u00e9es, des prestataires et des cha\u00eenes d'approvisionnement, ainsi que des cadres contractuels et r\u00e9glementaires. Ces d\u00e9pendances d\u2019ordres cognitives, organisationnelles, \u00e9conomiques restent largement implicites et sous d\u00e9velopp\u00e9es dans les travaux existants.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La caract\u00e9risation de ces d\u00e9pendances soul\u00e8ve par ailleurs une question d'\u00e9chelle. Analys\u00e9e au seul niveau du b\u00e2timent, la maintenance appara\u00eet comme une somme d'op\u00e9rations techniques ; replac\u00e9e \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, elle r\u00e9v\u00e8le des r\u00e9seaux d'acteurs, des fili\u00e8res, des comp\u00e9tences localement disponibles ou absentes, et des effets de d\u00e9pendance mutualis\u00e9s.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Contexte op\u00e9rationnel<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Du c\u00f4t\u00e9 des acteurs institutionnels et \u00e9conomiques, de nombreux outils accompagnent aujourd'hui la gestion technique du patrimoine b\u00e2ti. Nous pouvons citer :<\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les outils de gestion de maintenance assist\u00e9e par ordinateur (GMAO) et les plateformes de gestion technique du b\u00e2timent (GTB) ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les d\u00e9marches de mod\u00e9lisation des donn\u00e9es du b\u00e2timent (BIM d'exploitation, jumeaux num\u00e9riques) et les labels associ\u00e9s \u00e0 la connectivit\u00e9 des b\u00e2timents ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les contrats d'exploitation et de maintenance externalis\u00e9s, et les dispositifs de garantie de performance \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les d\u00e9marches et retours d'exp\u00e9rience issus de la mouvance low-tech (chantiers d\u00e9monstrateurs, guides praticiens, r\u00e9seaux associatifs).<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Ces dispositifs partagent une orientation commune : ils visent \u00e0 optimiser la conduite de la maintenance, rarement \u00e0 interroger les d\u00e9pendances qu'elle installe. Les d\u00e9marches low-tech, \u00e0 l'inverse, portent cette interrogation mais restent au stade de l'exp\u00e9rimentation ponctuelle, sans cadre d'\u00e9valuation partag\u00e9 ni capacit\u00e9 de g\u00e9n\u00e9ralisation \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle d'un parc ou d'un territoire.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Il en r\u00e9sulte, en l'\u00e9tat des connaissances aussi bien scientifiques qu'op\u00e9rationnelles, qu'il n'existe pas de m\u00e9thode permettant de rendre visibles et de qualifier les d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance et \u00e0 l'entretien des b\u00e2timents, ni d'\u00e9valuer dans quelle mesure une approche low-tech permettrait de les r\u00e9duire.<\/p><p><br>\ud83c\udfaf&nbsp;<strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Ce que nous attendons de vous<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>D\u00e9marche de la th\u00e8se<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">L'objectif principal de cette th\u00e8se est de caract\u00e9riser les apports d'une approche low-tech pour cartographier et ma\u00eetriser, sinon r\u00e9duire, les diff\u00e9rentes formes de d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance et \u00e0 l'entretien des b\u00e2timents.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Les d\u00e9pendances analys\u00e9es s'appuieront sur les techniques, pratiques, outils et r\u00e9seaux en lien avec la maintenance qui seront mis en \u00e9vidence dans les deux autres th\u00e8ses du projet <strong>PERENNIS<\/strong>. Cette th\u00e8se s'inscrit donc en compl\u00e8te continuit\u00e9 de ces deux travaux.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un premier temps, il s'agira de construire un cadre d'analyse des d\u00e9pendances li\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance du b\u00e2timent, articulant quatre registres : les ressources (\u00e9nergie, mati\u00e8re, pi\u00e8ces d\u00e9tach\u00e9es), les savoirs et savoir-faire, les acteurs et leurs relations contractuelles, et les r\u00e9seaux techniques et logistiques. Cette phase s'appuiera sur une revue de la litt\u00e9rature scientifique et \u00ab grise \u00bb, sur un benchmark des pratiques et outils de maintenance existants, et sur des entretiens avec les acteurs du secteur (gestionnaires de patrimoine, bailleurs, mainteneurs, bureaux d'\u00e9tudes, collectivit\u00e9s).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un deuxi\u00e8me temps, ce cadre sera mobilis\u00e9 pour caract\u00e9riser et rendre visibles les sch\u00e9mas de d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, sur un ou plusieurs territoires d'\u00e9tude. Il s'agira notamment d'identifier les sources de donn\u00e9es mobilisables pour objectiver ces sch\u00e9mas, de qualifier les points de fragilit\u00e9 et d'appr\u00e9cier leur variabilit\u00e9 selon les typologies de b\u00e2timents et les configurations d'acteurs.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un troisi\u00e8me temps, des strat\u00e9gies prospectives low-tech de maintenance et d'entretien seront propos\u00e9es et instruites. Il s'agira de construire des sc\u00e9narios contrast\u00e9s, d'\u00e9valuer leur capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 r\u00e9duire la vuln\u00e9rabilit\u00e9 technique, \u00e9conomique et sociale des op\u00e9rations de maintenance dans un contexte d'adaptation au changement climatique, et d'en discuter la faisabilit\u00e9 et l'acceptabilit\u00e9 avec les parties prenantes concern\u00e9es.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Verrous scientifiques :<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p>D\u00e9finition et op\u00e9rationnalisation de la notion de d\u00e9pendance appliqu\u00e9e \u00e0 la maintenance du b\u00e2ti, au-del\u00e0 de la seule d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource (savoirs, acteurs, organisations, r\u00e9seaux)<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Caract\u00e9risation et repr\u00e9sentation de sch\u00e9mas de d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, \u00e0 partir de donn\u00e9es h\u00e9t\u00e9rog\u00e8nes et partiellement indisponibles<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">\u00c9valuation prospective de strat\u00e9gies low-tech en l'absence de retours d'exp\u00e9rience consolid\u00e9s et de m\u00e9triques \u00e9tablies<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Articulation interdisciplinaire entre sciences de l'ing\u00e9nieur et sciences humaines et sociales, et capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 r\u00e9pliquer l'approche tout en visant la \u00ab parcimonie \u00bb des m\u00e9thodes et mod\u00e8les<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Objectifs de d\u00e9veloppement durable rattach\u00e9s :<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 11 \u2013 Villes et communaut\u00e9s durables \u00b7<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 12 \u2013 Consommation et production responsables<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 13 \u2013 Mesures relatives \u00e0 la lutte contre les changements climatiques.<\/p><figure><img style=\"width:408px\" src=\"https:\/\/recruitee-main.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com\/uploads\/bamvhl2ynlf2u26pdlba5e7ec83o17\/doctorat.png\"><\/figure> <br> <p>\ud83d\udd0d <strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Ce que nous recherchons<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Formation<\/strong> : Bac +5 en ing\u00e9nierie g\u00e9n\u00e9raliste, sciences de l'environnement, g\u00e9nie civil ou \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique du b\u00e2timent, g\u00e9ographie\/am\u00e9nagement, ou discipline connexe. Une formation ou une sensibilit\u00e9 aux sciences humaines et sociales (sociologie des techniques, STS, \u00e9conomie de la fonctionnalit\u00e9) serait un plus.<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Comp\u00e9tences requises<\/strong> :<\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>M\u00e9thodes qualitatives<\/u> : conduite et analyse d'entretiens semi-directifs, observation de terrain, analyse de corpus documentaires.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Analyse syst\u00e9mique et prospective<\/u> : capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 repr\u00e9senter un syst\u00e8me sociotechnique, \u00e0 construire et instruire des sc\u00e9narios.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Connaissance du b\u00e2timent<\/u> : compr\u00e9hension du fonctionnement technique du b\u00e2ti et de ses \u00e9quipements, et des logiques d'exploitation et de maintenance.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Traitement de donn\u00e9es<\/u> : aisance avec des donn\u00e9es h\u00e9t\u00e9rog\u00e8nes issues de sources vari\u00e9es ; la ma\u00eetrise d'outils de traitement (R, Python) ou de SIG (QGIS) serait appr\u00e9ci\u00e9e.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Gestion de projets<\/u> : aptitude \u00e0 structurer et mener des phases de projet de mani\u00e8re autonome, en articulation avec deux autres doctorants du projet.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Langue<\/strong> : fran\u00e7ais courant et anglais op\u00e9rationnel (capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 lire des publications techniques et scientifiques en anglais).<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Profil recherch\u00e9<\/strong> : individus responsables, proactifs, et dot\u00e9s d'un esprit analytique, capables de faire preuve de rigueur scientifique. Personnes dynamiques, motiv\u00e9es par les enjeux environnementaux et par le questionnement critique de la technique. Capacit\u00e9 d'adaptation, go\u00fbt pour le travail interdisciplinaire et collaboratif avec des acteurs vari\u00e9s.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>\ud83d\udce9 <strong><span That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325\u2013580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix\u2013vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix\u2013vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply\u2013accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What you will do<\/strong> <\/p><p>The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request. <\/p><p>1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network\u2019s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report. <\/p><p>2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured. <\/p><p>3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along. <\/p><p>4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy\u2013 accuracy frontier for INL\u2019s PCM-based photonic matrix\u2013vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement.<\/p> <br> <p><strong>Who we are looking for Required<\/strong> <\/p><p>\u2022 A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract. <\/p><p>\u2022 A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov\u2019s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models. <\/p><p>\u2022 Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin\/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure. <\/p><p>\u2022 Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI. <\/p><p>\u2022 Working English; French is not required. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Valued, not required<\/strong> <\/p><p>Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What matters most<\/strong> <\/p><p>We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy\u2013quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What we offer<\/strong> <\/p><p>\u2022 A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner \u00e0 chaque personne la possibilit\u00e9 d&#39;acheter ce qu&#39;elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et o\u00f9 elle le veut.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Nous sommes une entreprise ax\u00e9e sur la technologie, \u00e0 l&#39;avant-garde d\u2019un secteur qui conna\u00eet une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avan\u00e7ons rapidement, valorisons l&#39;autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles id\u00e9es et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ce que vous ferez au quotidien&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;En tant que &lt;strong&gt;Account Associate - Retail &amp;amp; Grocery (H\/F)&lt;\/strong&gt;, vous serez responsable du succ\u00e8s d\u2019un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d\u2019assurer la meilleure exp\u00e9rience \u00e0 nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures ad\u00e9quates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert \u00e0 la nouveaut\u00e9.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une soci\u00e9t\u00e9 qui \u00e9volue \u00e0 grande vitesse et \u00e0 grande \u00e9chelle. Vous aurez l\u2019opportunit\u00e9 de cr\u00e9er et am\u00e9liorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer \u00e0 la croissance. Vous \u00e9laborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes sp\u00e9cifiques et pour l&#39;ensemble du portefeuille&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Relations avec les magasins Retail et\/ou Grocery : Vous g\u00e9rerez le d\u00e9veloppement des partenariats, le suivi des donn\u00e9es, et vous assurerez une exp\u00e9rience optimale sur l\u2019application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison \u00e0 domicile de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en \u00e9tant l&#39;expert de votre zone \/ ville.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ce qu\u2019il vous faut pour r\u00e9ussir&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Exp\u00e9rience : stage ou alternance dans un r\u00f4le d\u2019Account management ou commercial. Une exp\u00e9rience terrain au sein d\u2019un grand groupe (id\u00e9alement supermarch\u00e9, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Commercial : vous avez \u00e0 c\u0153ur de n\u00e9gocier, d\u2019anticiper des discussions commerciales, d\u2019entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualit\u00e9 (discussions contractuelles, n\u00e9gociations de mise en place d&#39;outils commerciaux, etc)&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Entrepreneur : vous avez le go\u00fbt pour entreprendre, cr\u00e9er, aller chercher des opportunit\u00e9s, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre t\u00e9l\u00e9phone pour comprendre vos partenaires.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Analytique :  capable d\u2019\u00eatre synth\u00e9tique, d&#39;approfondir les donn\u00e9es et de comprendre les donn\u00e9es qui permettent d&#39;am\u00e9liorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez \u00eatre sur le terrain et vous \u00eates impliqu\u00e9(e) dans tout ce qui est op\u00e9rationnel dans votre p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Centr\u00e9 sur le client : \u00eatre obs\u00e9d\u00e9 par nos clients. Utiliser des donn\u00e9es quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit op\u00e9rationnellement excellent pour nos clients.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Jouer en \u00e9quipe : un joueur d&#39;\u00e9quipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement \u00e0 tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de r\u00e9ussir avec et par les autres.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Optimiste, confiant et plein d&#39;\u00e9nergie :  vous apportez de la fra\u00eecheur, de l&#39;\u00e9nergie et de la passion dans l&#39;\u00e9quipe.  Vous contribuez \u00e0 cr\u00e9er un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles id\u00e9es et agr\u00e9able pour les autres personnes impliqu\u00e9es.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Langues : Fran\u00e7ais et Anglais courant indispensables. &lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Nous sommes des passionn\u00e9s de food, des problem-solvers, des cr\u00e9ateurs de communaut\u00e9 et bien plus encore. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible \u2014 compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>The Role<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install \u2014 all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">But the job is building and leading a team from day one \u2014 hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. The r\u00f4le ensure strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;Data Governance Director&lt;\/strong&gt;, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets.
