We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">At Ledger, we\u2019re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world\u2019s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets \u2013 including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What you\u2019ll be doing:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Vision: <\/strong>Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>End-to-End Ownership: <\/strong>Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration \u2014 writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data-Driven Decision Making: <\/strong>Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner &amp; Ecosystem Management: <\/strong>Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what \u201cearning with Ledger\u201d means for our users.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership: <\/strong>Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance \u2014 especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Team &amp; Stakeholder Communication: <\/strong>Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What we\u2019re looking for:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Vision: <\/strong>Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>End-to-End Ownership: <\/strong>Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration \u2014 writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data-Driven Decision Making: <\/strong>Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner &amp; Ecosystem Management: <\/strong>Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what \u201cearning with Ledger\u201d means for our users.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership: <\/strong>Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance \u2014 especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Team &amp;
